title: ORE Expenses Module
description: Operating expense schedule with recoverability flags. Amounts are annualized as of rentRoll.asOfDate and grow per the expense growth assumption in marketAssumptions unless an item carries its own growth override.

notes.description: Free-text notes on the expense schedule as a whole (source statements, normalization adjustments).

expenseId.description: Stable identifier, unique within the file. Referenced by leases' reimbursement.excludedExpenses.

category.description: Standard category for cross-file comparability and standards mapping. Use the name field for the shop-specific label.

amount.description: Annual amount in the unit declared by amountUnit, as of rentRoll.asOfDate.

amountUnit.description: totalPerYear: USD per year. perSFPerYear: USD per SF of property.physical.buildingSF per year. percentOfEGR: percent of effective gross revenue (the conventional management fee basis) — amount is the percent value, e.g. 2.5.

recoverable.description: Whether the expense is recoverable from tenants, subject to each lease's reimbursement structure and exclusions.

controllable.description: Whether the expense is a controllable expense, subject to a lease's controllable-expense cap (reimbursement.expenseCap). When omitted, the engine defaults by category: real_estate_taxes, insurance, and utilities are non-controllable; all others are controllable. Only matters when a recovering lease carries an expenseCap.

belowTheLine.description: True for items excluded from NOI but included in cash flow (conventionally capital reserves).

growthOverridePercent.description: Annual growth rate in percent for this item only, overriding marketAssumptions.growth.expenses. Has no effect on percentOfEGR items, which float with revenue.
